title: Discriminating between Attributes
pinyin: Zhī rén zhě zhì， zì zhī zhě míng。
Shèng rén zhě yǒu lì， zì shèng zhě qiáng。
Bù shī qí suǒ zhě jiǔ。
Sǐ ér bù wáng zhě shòu。
english: He who knows other men is discerning; he who knows himself is intelligent. He who overcomes others is strong; he who overcomes himself is mighty. He who is satisfied with his lot is rich; he who goes on acting with energy has a (firm) will.
He who does not fail in the requirements of his position, continues long; he who dies and yet does not perish, has longevity.
